pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarissā visikhāya piṇḍāya caramānā yena aññataraṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.3: athakho te manussā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ bhojetvā etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.6: kathaṃ aññā bhikkhuniyo nāgaccheyyunti bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.7: amukasmiṃ ayye okāse vālā sunakhā caṇḍo balibaddo cikkhallo okāso
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.9: aññatarāpi bhikkhunī tassā visikhāya piṇḍāya caramānā yena taṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.10: athakho te manussā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ bhojetvā etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.12: athakho sā bhikkhunī tesaṃ manussānaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.18: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.21.1: yā pana bhikkhunī kulamaccharinī assa pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:2.1.6: cattāri kulāni khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:2.1.8: kathaṃ bhikkhuniyo nāgaccheyyunti bhikkhunīnaṃ santike kulassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:2.1.9: kulassa vā santike bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati āpatti pācittiyassa.
